newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai 1996 exports estimated at $12.8-$13 bln.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai 1996 exports estimated at $12.8-$13 bln.

text.p: Shanghai's exports this year are estaimated to reach a full-year value of $12.8 billion to $13 billion, an increase of about 11-12 percent over 1995, the official Liberation Daily newspaper said on Sunday.

The newspaper said the value of exports in the first 11 months of the year from foreign-invested enterprises in the city, China's largest manufacturing centre, was up 50.57 percent over the same 1995 period, but gave no detailed figures.
